meta.name: blog-brand
meta.description: Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption. Generates BRAND.md (audience, positioning, do/don't editorial rules, taboo phrases, competitor differentiation) and VOICE.md (existing persona JSON re-expressed as readable prose), both written to the project root. When present, all blog sub-skills auto-load these files before writing or reviewing. Pairs with blog-persona, which manages the structured persona JSON. Use when user says "blog brand", "create brand context", "brand voice doc", "BRAND.md", "VOICE.md", "establish editorial brand", "brand guidelines for blog".

copy.tagline: 为博客项目建立品牌与声音指南文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为博客或内容创作团队建立统一的品牌和语调规范。
copy.tagline_en: Establish brand and voice guidelines for your blog project.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create consistent brand and voice documentation for your blog or content team.
